lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized into roughly vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, exhibiting a nodal grid-like spatial distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with and encompass the primary high-luminance blobs, forming structured intersections along the lateral midline.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear horizontal feature visible across the superior third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance reflectance on the dorsal edge and a shadowed boundary below.

other_distinctive_markers: Clear morphological transition from high-density, small-diameter speckling on the cranial/rostral region to larger, more dispersed spot-and-stripe configurations on the post-branchial flank.
